items.note: Stellar experience. No wait time, incredible steak, never left hungry, great sides and salad bar
One of my favorite burgers ever, awesome mac n cheese, loved making bubble tea with Mom's old boss. Very sad it's gone
Best wings, period. Super juicy and flavorful Reuben burger. Love the street corn bites / other apps. Only thing I dislike is their fries.
Need to go there more to know for sure, but incredible cheesesteak and nachos. A bit expensive, but I love the variety. Nicky Santoro sandwich with hot pepper aioli was amazing
Route 130 is a treat of a cheesesteak. Like their corn nuggets and raspberry lime rickey soda a lot. Lovely interior / environment
Wonderful steak, potatoes, sweet corn brulee, and brussels sprouts
One of my favorite lemony chicken dishes ever. Love sitting outside / environment. Street corn dip is wonderful

This goes for any hibachi place, but it's objectively the best experience when I want chinese food. Best freshest noodles / fried rice, tender steak and chicken. Only feels right for a special occasion though.
One of the best sandwiches I ever had: Hot honey chicken mac n cheese sandwich. Crazy $19 peanut butter milkshake was a sight to behold. Decorated all over the place that makes you feel special
Wider variety than Cava, more convenient, and better tasting drinks. Flavorful Mediterranean wraps, makes me feel healthier

Had it for the first time on my road trip, instantly hooked. Super juicy crispy chicken with a lovely lemon pepper seasoning to go with it. FAT crinkle cut fries, bold sauce, nice coleslaw, strawberry nerds milkshake was cool
Wonderful mediterranean food, makes me feel healthy. Memories with coworkers. Usually get a bowl. Needs more sauce, but otherwise great. Service has been kinda ass lately though
One of the best cheesesteaks ever, glad it comes with tots. I've liked many other dishes there too, but am sad they removed some of my favorites.
Awesome garlic bread cheesesteak, great for ice cream, love the vibe. Sad it's seasonal / they don't always have the ice cream flavor I want
Incredibly tasty cheesesteak, but a bit messy. This introduced me to cooper sharp cheese and I love em for it. Can do without the seeded roll though

Had it on my road trip. Love the environment, sharpie on the walls. Very tasty sandwiches and milkshakes, me and my friend had half of each other's. Hot pig & Fig and "king bee" wrap. That pimento cheese was something else
Went there on my road trip, need to go there again. Super tasty broccoli cheddar soup, Deli cowboy sandwich was loaded with juicy brisket, and FREE SOFT SERVE with every meal!
Always a treat. Love the honey bbq chicken super melt + other unhealthy but inventive foods, always finishing with ice cream. Sometimes slow though, mom's food didn't look great. But I still have fun

Pork roll mac n cheese is great and cheesy. Short rib sandwich I had the first time was awesome, but they didn't have it last time I went. Got the Delmonico which had steak and long hots on it, which wasn't the best but still pretty good. Nice vibe and decorations
Favorite hot chicken place, lemon pepper is a nice addon
Second favorite hot chicken place, more variety, less punchy spice. Kickass peanut butter shake, but it's real expensive.
Super meaty burgers, tasty fries and shakes, but often too expensive to justify. Also like eating peanuts while I wait
Great to meet up with friends. Steak sandwich was phenomenal, liked their cucumber refresher and getting a bloomin' onion. Lovely sides
Need to go there more to confirm, but that rustic slice with pepperoni and ricotta might be one of my new favorite pizzas. White pie also really tasty, and also raspberry lime rickey.
Always love going here, a quick little chicken finger meal with Texas toast and yummy sauce. Good memories of going to the turtle lake with Sydney after getting these. Love their fries
Need to go there more. One of the best pasta dishes ever for restaurant week, but that was just for then.
Vodka rig pizza, general tso's pizza, short rib ravioli. Not all dinners are the best there, but they have some major hits
Loved that one time we went. Great atmosphere, lots of tasty pizzas. I kept asking who wanted what slices to make sure I wouldn't eat all the ones that others wanted. I need that pickle pizza again.
Incredible butternut squash beignets and chicken, expensive special occasion
Incredible flavorful chicken, licked my plate clean and wanted more.  expensive special occasion

Nice soft bread with olive oil, tasty garlic knots, roasted Peppers were nice with the bread, Surprisingly fresh salad with roast Peppers and Russian dressing, lovely grandma pizza, excellent chicken / veal piccata, and a nice little cannoli to finish. Next time we need to get the stuffed long hots because we forgot to order them
Very unique take on a cheesesteak that is very satisfying to eat. Glad there's a version without poppyseeds, but I do still like them from time to time.
Super savory short rib melt sandwich and a nice outdoor deck to sit on. Shame it's so far in north Jersey
Super soft and cheesy boli calzone that I like more than pepperoni bread. Pizza is good, chicken parm sando is great

items.label: Restaurants I remember having an "I'm so happy right now" moment

items.note: Slow, but worth the wait for such a juicy chicken sandwich

Great spot to go with the boys, I really like their lemon pepper and garlic parm wings. Glad they have so many sauces to choose from that you can mix and match. Also they have a really meaty burger and super tasty potato wedges. Love their BOGO boneless wing thursdays
A ton of food for the price, kick ass ribs and mac n cheese. Love going there with Bette
Lovely fast food burger joint. A little greasy, but I like their options and the vibe
Expensive, but tasty white pie. Red pie is just pretty good.
Amazing lemony chicken, but think it was a special order. Not sure if they still have it.
I want my baby back baby back baby back ribsssss. Many lovely meals there with friends, only a couple things I didn't care for like the sauced mozarella sticks and their white cheddar mac.

My most visited place by far. Great flavors and always play songs I end up shazaming, but very inconsistent. It can be real cheap and bigger than you expected or really expensive and smaller than you expected. All depends on the day, and what seasonal items are out.
LOVE their roast beef sandwich and their crispy shoestring fries, but wasn't super happy with the breakfast sandwich I got that one time. Also they had a great corn soup
My favorite place for chinese food not counting hibachi. They got the best sweet & sour chicken and lo mein.
Chipotle chicken pasta is great, love getting the cheesesteak eggrolls and a slice of cheesecake to finish the night
One of the few tomato pies I really enjoy. The bread is nice and soft and there's still a cheesiness to it. A bit messy, but I like it.
Real good burger. Coworkers commented on how fast I finished it. Need to go there more
Lovely spot for friends, I enjoy getting a big beefy burger and the pineapple jalapeno wings
Under the new owners, the fried chicken is incredible. Calzone was just okay though.
Wide variety of options, many including a number of breakfast meats I like. Lovely hot chocolate, fun to go for breakfast, but unsure how it will do under new ownership
Pigs in a blanket are awesome. Haven't had too much else there though, at least not in a long while.
Had some very nice chicken there, also like how they have a little candy chest at the end. Not too much on the menu I would eat though.
Meat was not the best quality, but still pretty good. I like that they have a pork roll cheesesteak option
Went there on my road trip. Absolutely went overboard on the food, massive plate of buffalo chicken mac and cheese, corn nuggets, fried calamari, and a starter salad. All super tasty though
Had some very inventive sliders, this is the place I went to when I was in Texas
Only had it once when in Texas. Had a sandwich like the one I like from friendly's. Would like more
Solid lunch spot for a chicken sandwich, very cheesy mac n cheese which is fun to put on my sandwich
A bit of a wait and sometimes the chicken feels "wet" under the breading, but tastes good and has crispy skin. I like the cheesling powder
Only been there once, tasty BBQ, less pricy than More than Q
Lovely little joint for mexican, I enjoyed eating Dad's leftovers
I would only get the chili lime chicken thighs which were super flavorful and cheap compared to the other stuff, but otherwise it was too expensive.
HUGE sandwiches, treat of a pizza slice
Great chicken piccata
Huge sandwiches, not the most flavorful, but a nice little spot
I miss their corn cake so often. Think the actual tacos and main meal was good as well
Don't remember too much about what I got, but I remember liking it
I dunno why we don't go here more often. I'd say it's similar to Pete's but I can't remember
Only went once. Had a massive tasty BBQ spread, though it was pricy.
Took forever the first time, much faster the second time. The wings were crispy and tasted nice. Lemon pepper chicken sandwich w/ ranch was great. Sour patch kids chicken honestly wasn't terrible
Tasty short rib pizza, don't remember how the other pizza was
Short Rib Waffle Cones were very inventive and tasty
Tasty burger and shoestring fries, haven't been there enough to know more
Went here on my road trip. Very vibrant interior with a sea theme, super tasty crispy cheese appetizer, also some nice lamb.
Very inventive and tasty hoagies, they just need more sauce
Really nice pastrami burger, great diner to go to as a default
Tasty burger and MASSIVE amount of chicken bites for a crazy cheap price. Need to pat down the chicken to get some of the grease off first cuz otherwise it makes me feel sick
Really enjoyed their burger and cheese curds, need to go there more
Tasty street corn dip, meatloaf was mid.
I get it more for convenience over flavor, but pretty solid food. only the chow mein was gross. Everything else is pretty good
Tastes good, but too expensive for what it is. Most halal food trucks in philly were on par. A proper restaurant wouldn't "run out" of food like they do.
Occasionally hits, not always. Sometimes I'm left hungry
Favorite of the "long standing" fast food burger joints, comes in clutch with 50 nuggets.
Slightly above average burger, I just don't feel like going there as much compared to chipotle
Had some tasty soups there and nice burgers
Solid chicken, but pricy.
I remember liking the rolls and having a good time, not much else though. Need to go there more

Many different things I'll get from them, but they are charging way too much for some of them. Also really mad at them for discontinuing my favorite item for a SECOND time after only having it back for a month.
favorite fast food pizza place, but only good if you get no toppings. Kinda getting pricy.
Solid crispy chicken for cheap, nice mac n cheese, but other sides are not great.

Some REALLY tasty items on there, like the kartoffelpuffer and the german mac n cheese, but the sausages aren't anything crazy. I do like sitting outside on the deck, but inside it's super hot and there were cob webs under the table. If they're gonna do karaoke again, they need to take down the speakers.
Your average slice / pizza place
I like the variety of pizzas they got, but not the best quality
Very nice burger from there, but the fries are greasy and mushy. Pop got mad at them for how much it cost and the fact that he ordered the wrong thing.
Some interesting choices on the menu, but the place feels cramped and they don't bring a ton of flavor. Decent food, just not 'great'.
I'll get a grilled cheese n fries with pork roll in it. Comfort food that reminds me of when I was younger, but getting more expensive and is kinda too greasy at times
Average burger, too cramped to sit inside so you gotta order it out
Nice tasting BBQ, but I prefer mission
Tasty pizza we get for work events
Liked their boom boom pizza a lot, but not a very sanitary place. Also their wings sucked.
Your average little pizza spot. Plain slice is fine, vodka rigatoni pizza tastes good, french fry pizza was eh. Crust is a bit brittle
used to like them much more than I do now. Around the same as bella mia
Solid sandwiches, like the options. Also nice and small, not overwhelming, but a little more expensive than I want it to be
Massive bowls of ramen that are hard to finish, but tasty. Not sure if it's worth the price at times
Sausage pizza they made one time was awesome. Other pizzas are just alright most of the time.
Less sweet than Papa John's, but about the same
Like Cava but less fresh.

It's good steak and food, but the whole experience feels weird. The chocolate coins at the end are strange, and it feels way too expensive for what you get. Also the place is always super cramped inside.
Only went there once on my trip. Nice little burger and hush puppies, but I really wish I had time to try one of their many shakes.
Steak served on a wood plank - weird. Also pretty raw for medium rare. Cauliflower wings were okay. Great apple butter cheesecake the first time we went though.
Average chinese place
I like their mac and cheese and they had a good butternut squash soup, but I never really feel compelled to go there. Did like getting a cinnamon roll when I was little though
Alright, don't remember too much, just that I went there with mom
Your average tasty slice of pizza. But why do they need to seat you? Took longer than it should have.
I liked their white pie, and have fond memories going there after soccer when I was little. Sad it's gone.
I remember it being good, better than Allstar or Jimmy's when it was those
Short rib ravioli was surprisingly nice. I could tell it's not a high quality place though. Likely need to try more to confirm. I remember mom wasn't too happy about it.
Steak was kinda average. Not sure too much about other stuff
better than the other Qdoba adjacent places because they have ground beef as an option
I've liked some of their limited time items like their wings and cheesesteak, but the roast beef is just okay.
I like the place conceptually. Not the best chicken in the world, but it tastes good enough and they give you a good bit of sides to choose from.
Pizza isn't the best, but I've had some alright dinners there.
I haven't had it too much but it just kinda seems like your average fast food burger place to me.
Similar to Qdoba, a little better
Very middle of the road for these kind of places. No option for ground beef.
The one time we did get to go it was alright, although I think getting sweet chili sauce was a mistake. I do like that they have a ton of options though.
Was cool when cheesesteak eggrolls were a new thing, but that's about all I remember enjoying from the place. I've always wanted to sit in the middle area but never get to.

items.label: I've had an actual problem with the food I ate here (for the most part)

items.note: I like that they got Laziza. Still haven't tried this place too much so the rank may improve, but the shwarma was decent, if just a bit dry. There was some weird pickled thing that came with it though that tasted nasty.
The dosa tasted good, but those donut things I got were very strange. Also the guy behind the counter spilled cheese everywhere when plating my dosa because he put it on upside down.
Food is chewier than I want Chinese food to be, but flavor is fine
Long time since I've been there, I think it was alright, but that's it. Feels like it wants to be higher quality than it is

My love for Wawa has faded over time. Pure middle of the road sustenance. I've had some really good experiences like getting the Gobbler and some bad experiences like when they gave me food poisoning. I will eat it as long as it's still not too pricy, but the price is rising.
Average Italian place, no strong compulsion to go there other than being with family. Always cramped getting in.
Passable mexican food, but kinda slow. They don't do proper elote
The pure definition of "too much." Dry aged steak is an interesting flavor, but buy in large everything is just too rich and hard to stomach
Burger was decent, but their "peanut butter" shake was basically just vanilla and that kinda upset me.
Had some good memories from Denny's, but mostly getting mac n cheese with goldfish as a kid. Sometimes really slow service. Nice cinnamon hot cocoa
Alright slices, had some pesto pasta with sausage that disappointed.

Just an average pizza, nothing really special. I remember really disliking it before, but the last time I had it there was nothing wrong with it. Points for seasoned crust. The Pizza Box smelled like ass though.
Was interesting to try, but the water is gross and all the food makes you thirsty from all the seasonings on it. No dishes you actually think of when it comes to "indian food"
Biscuits are nice, but almost too buttery. Crispy chicken that's not too chickeny. Alright, but feels like I'm eating a lot of grease

Like a bit better shake shack, but still just okay. Burger was good, but felt small like McDonalds. 10 bucks value box had burger, chicken bites, fries and sauce. Sauce was not my favorite. Chicken bites were hard at times. Big "blue wave" shake for 6 dollars. Better than shake shack, but not a really distinguishable flavor. Upset that they made me put in my phone number to order
I can find a sandwich I like I guess, but only after searching through the other wet italian sandwiches with stuff on it that I don't want.
Had a tasty quesabirria from them, although greasy, but they really don't know how to make a good horchata. I was getting hard bits of cinnamon in my mouth.
Chewy sesame chicken, reminds me of Panda Express, not great.

Way too expensive now for what you get. Bacon Egg & cheese McGriddle and quarter pounder with cheese are the only things I would go out of my way to get, but they're too expensive now to justify. Even mcFlurry's feel like a rip off
Burger was disappointing and charred
Haven't been there in a long time, don't really remember, but I don't think I was too crazy about the food.
Food is very mid and dry, would only really go for a blizzard, but I have other places I prefer for ice cream.

I can't remember the last time I've actually been in a physical White Castle, but the microwave burgers are a nice little snack every once in a while and they taste the same. Not really worth making a meal though
I like going there with the family, but the food in general is kinda bland. and the portions are huge.
A burger that tastes fine but is so small you feel like you're getting ripped off. Fries feel kind of fake and their shakes are lame.
This business model just does not work right. There's a reason why the place is always empty. Crust always has like a layer of dust on it
Yucky mac n cheese, lukewarm food. Might be better trying it again, but I didn't have a good impression
charred burger, not a great flavor
Sus food. Has things I am curious to try, but have ended up making me feel not great after eating.
Very middle of the road pizza.

I really love their veal piccata, but the sides seem prepared a little differently each time. I also like the dated environment because it feels unique, but the salad I had last time was horrible and there's never anybody in there. I don't think the owner who seems to be the only server can handle a larger crowd. Kinda slow

Hard to rank. I have good memories there of their breakfast, but the last time I went it felt like things were microwaved and chewy. I want to try it down south to see if it's better like my southern friends say.
Food tasted good, but tiny portions and aggressive marketing / ordering system made me upset.
Would only go there for the biscuits, which I can get at the store anyway.
I only think about their breadsticks. I liked them a lot, but a group of my friends apparently all got sick after eating those together.

items.label: Will still go here without protest

items.note: Very dry tacos, salsa that comes with the chips is very bitter for some reason.
Brittle burnt crust on overly tomatoey pizza pie. Only went there once, not feeling it again.
Love their packaged snacks to death. Their brisket wrap I got was very chewy and sad for brisket though.
Do not like the "flame broil" they try to add to the burger. I like the chicken fries, but I would never seek them out.

Attached to whole hog, not much better. The only saving grace is that they're cheap. Got 5 chicken tenders with mac n cheese for only like 11 bucks. But they weren't great. Lemon pepper seasoning was all pepper and no lemon and I didn't feel good. Mac was just okay. Stupid name
Curry chicken tasted good, but there was so much bone compared to actual chicken. The roti bread was very hard to chew through, not worth getting
Really haven't been there in a long time to tell. All I remember is getting chicken fingers and french fries which were kinda hard. Think there's a reason we don't go there anymore.
Nice wings, but those "riblets" I got were a crime. Kept chomping down on hard flat bones that did not need to be in there. Sauce made napkins stick to my hands.
terrible garlic parm wings, very greasy food, almost made me sick getting a burger from there at the airport.

Cheesesteak is a single steak-umm on a roll. Burger is charry and gross. You go there only for the soda or a float, but even those feel off now that they use plastic cups, unless that was weber's before that had the actual mugs.
Alright burger, but offensively bad chicken pot pie. Not sad they went under.
Gave me a raw burger the first time, but they fixed it. It was a "mac n cheese" burger that only had 6 noodles on it.

Whatever red meat I got was good, but that chicken leg did not look safe to eat. Asked for another and it looked the same inside so I threw it out. Absolute idiot behind the register didn't know what he was doing. Bbq sauces aren't that good
Had it on my road trip. Like a build your own Asian bowl type of place. The one I went to was just so bland though, and the vegetables looked dirty. Nasty stuff.
Flavorless burger with giant wet vegetables on a flaky kaiser roll, absolutely awful zucchini "sticks" that I got because I thought they'd be like illiano's. Hot fried log of sour mush.
Went there to try chicharrones for the first time. They were edible, but stank real bad. The guy cut them up with scissors and didn't have gloves on. Felt unsafe to eat. Place was dingy and dirty.
One of the only places I almost threw up while eating. Horrendous meat dish floating in terrible sauce.
Worst cheesesteak I've ever eaten. All the meat was strung together like it was on a string, and had to pull it out of my mouth because I could not chew it. Almost threw up.

I don't really know how to describe the flavor, but it's a refreshing sweetness that doesn't overpower you at all. I could drink them all day, and they still taste great when diluted. Thankfully they come in small bottles too

A marvelous fruity taste with some added thickness. Felt like I was drinking a tropical milkshake. Like a peach and a strawberry. Can't drink it too much, but I would have it all the time if it were good for me.
Lovely refreshing beverage with my favorite cherry flavor, not too tart and not too artificial. Also love the glass bottle, and I think it's better for you for being sweetened with Stevia.
Wonderfully creamy melon flavored drink, reminds me of melona popsicles which I also love
Always a treat. I like that it feels like a dessert drink, liquid ice cream. Sometimes it can feel like a bit much, but when you want to indulge you go for it
Iconic, my first choice for any mainstream soda. I can never pin down what the flavor is supposed to be, but it feels more special than a regular cola
Like melon flavored calpico with bits of aloe vera. Lovely creamy and refreshing flavor. Aloe vera is unnecessary, but not super offensive
Nostalgic taste of royalty, would take it over root beer any day. Steeps into that mint / root beer barrel flavor
Will always pick this over any plain orange soda. It really helps the orange flavor so much without it being overpowering
Favorite snapple flavor, always refreshing and a great example of good raspberry flavor
Haven't had it in a while, but a beautiful mix of flavors
A treat of a soda
A nice treat whenever I go to granny & pops. Complements dinner well

Haven't had it in a long time, but I remember liking how powerful the flavor is through the fizz
Quaint creamy soda that has a nice color and label
Very refreshing for a raspberry flavor. Will prefer this over regular iced tea if they have it
The fizzle and tang of mountain dew with added refreshingness
Dr. Pepper only loses points with their other flavors, but this is still a nice flavor combo
Sweet orange cream creaminess
Great drink mom used to get us
First poppi flavor I tried, enjoy the tang of the lime without it being too bad for me compared to the other drinks on the list.
